part: Centre driveshaft of the Carten T410R (NHA413) with the fixed metal pins, the cup joints (NBA255), the rear pinion shaft (NBA205) with the spur gear (NBA252) and the bearing NBA298, the motor mount with its cap (NBA201) and the diff outdrives. Stock parts, not part of the speedrun design, not verified, work in progress. Modelled for the completeness of the build (assembly of the speedrun chassis). Files: cad/stock_parts/driveshaft, rear_drive, motor_mount and diff_outdrive, generated with scripts/cad/generate_driveshaft.py from this parameter file.
coordinate_system: Chassis plate coordinates (assembly): pinion axis at x = 0, z = plate thickness + axis_z of the lower bulkhead, y along the car (End B at y = 0). Part coordinates of the files: driveshaft along y from 0 to its length (pins along x); cup joint along y, back face at y = 0; rear pinion shaft along y, y = 0 end face of the pinion housing (negative inside the bulkhead); spur gear and bearing along y from y = 0; motor mount and cap: x = 0 pinion axis, y = 0 middle of the motor mount, z = 0 bottom face (top face of the chassis plate); diff outdrive along +x, back face at x = 0.
design: Round shaft with a ball end at each end. Each ball end carries a metal pin (NBA255 2.0x7.6), which is fixed on the shaft and runs in the slots of the cup joint, so the shaft turns with the cup joint. At End A the cup joint sits on the front pinion shaft beside the bulkhead. At End B (motor) the rear pinion shaft NBA205 runs from the pinion in the bulkhead through a flange with the spur gear and the bearing NBA298 in the motor mount NBA201 (manual steps 5, 10 and 12); the cup joint sits on its end beyond the motor mount. In the centred position, each pin has the axial play / 2 to the closed end of its slot, so the shaft can move a little back and forth.
derived_from_the_model: Pinion axis: x = 0, 2.0 + 17.2 = 19.2 above the bottom face of the chassis plate (axis_z of the lower bulkhead). End faces of the pinion housings: 27.9 from the origins of the bulkheads at y = 21.53 (End B) and 287.36 (End A, rotated by 180 degrees): y = 49.43 and 259.46. Motor mount: screws in the holes H09 and H10 of the chassis plate (y = 62.48, H10 below the pinion axis). Spur gear: in the slot of the chassis plate below the pinion axis (y = 50.28 to 56.97, 22.35 wide), which it needs, since it reaches 0.68 above the bottom face of the plate. Motor window from y = 65.63 (the motor face lies at the motor mount).

source_codes.user: Measurement or information of the owner
source_codes.manual: T410R instruction manual: part numbers, sizes and order of the parts in the assembly steps (no dimensions)
source_codes.plate: Hole pattern and cutouts of the speedrun chassis plate
source_codes.derived: Calculated from other values or from the bulkhead model
source_codes.standard: Typical dimension of 1:10 touring cars, not measured on the car

open_points: Not measured: thickness of the motor mount and of the spur gear, flange of the rear pinion shaft, the gaps between the motor mount or the pinion housing and the cup joints, depth of the bore of the cup joints. The length of the shaft follows from these values; it is to be checked against the real NHA413.

cup_od.note: Outer diameter of the cup joints NBA255.

cup_length.note: Length of the cup joints from the back face to the open end.

cup_bore_d.note: Inner diameter of the cup joints (bore for the ball end of the shaft). Manual step 5: an O-ring NBA255 5.8x9.6x1.9 belongs to the cup joint (not modelled).

cup_slot_len.note: Length of the two slots for the metal pin of the shaft, from the open end of the cup joint.

cup_back_bore.note: Back end of the cup joints: bore for the pinion shaft (diameter 5.0, the cup joint is pushed onto the pinion shaft, owner) and its depth from the back face (7.5, assumption; 0.6 wall to the bore for the ball end).

cup_groove.note: Groove at the back end of the cup joints for the O-ring NBA255 5.8x9.6x1.9 (manual step 5), which secures the retaining pin: from and to (from the back face) and diameter in the groove (photos of the owner with a ruler).

cup_pin_d.note: Retaining pin NBA255 2.0x7.6 (manual step 5): diameter; it goes through the cross hole in the groove of the cup joint and through the pinion shaft (owner).

cup_pin_length.note: Length of the retaining pin of the cup joint (manual step 5); it lies in the groove and is held by the O-ring (not modelled).

cup_slot_w.note: Width of the two slots (metal pin 2.0).

cup_bore_depth.note: Depth of the bore from the open end: slot 7.7 + 2.5 (space for the ball end and the O-ring beyond the closed end of the slot). Not measured.

cup_gap.note: End A: gap between the end face of the front pinion housing and the back face of the cup joint (shims 5x7 on the pinion shaft, manual step 5).

rear_cup_gap.note: End B: gap between the motor mount and the back face of the cup joint on the end of the rear pinion shaft.

pinion_shaft_d.note: Rear pinion shaft NBA205 outside the bulkhead: bearings 5x10x4 (manual step 5).

flange_d.note: Flange (mounting plate of the spur gear) of the rear pinion shaft NBA205: diameter (photos of the owner, scaled with the spur gear 39.16), on the bulkhead side of the spur gear.

flange_t.note: Thickness of the flange of the rear pinion shaft (side photo, scaled with the bearings 4.0).

spur_teeth.note: Standard spur gear 72T, 48 DP (owner). The specifications spec_spur_gear.yaml and spec_gearing.yaml and the setup sheet list 68T.

spur_dp.note: Diametral pitch of the spur gear. Outer diameter: (72 + 2) / 48 inch = 39.16; it reaches 0.38 below the bottom face of the chassis plate through the slot.

spur_bore_d.note: Centre bore of the spur gear on the spigot of the rear pinion shaft (9.3).

spur_screw_r.note: Radius of the 4 screw holes of the spur gear (4 screws M3 into the threads of the flange, owner and manual step 5); photos of the owner scaled with the spur gear.

spur_screw_d.note: Diameter of the 4 screw holes of the spur gear. The teeth are modelled with a simplified trapezoidal profile between the tip and the root circle (not involute); the lightening holes of the stock spur gear are not modelled.

mount_y.note: Centre plane of the motor mount NBA201: holes H09 and H10 of the chassis plate (2 screws M3x8 from below, manual step 10).

mount_t.note: Thickness of the motor mount in y (caliper, measurement sheet MM6).

tap_d.note: Tap drill of the M3 threads (ISO metric thread M3 x 0.5). The STEP files contain no thread geometry: the threads are modelled as holes with the tap drill diameter.

mount_tap_depth.note: Drill depth of the M3 threads of the motor mount: screws M3x8 from below through the 2.0 chassis plate (6.0 thread engagement) and screws M3x18 through the top brace (2.0) and the cap (10.2) into the low part (5.8 thread engagement).

mount_bottom_screws.note: Threads M3 in the bottom face of the motor mount for the screws M3x8 from below through the holes H09 and H10 of the chassis plate (manual step 10).

mount_x.note: Extent of the motor mount across the car: around the holes H10 (x = 0) and H09 (x = 45.33) and below the screw of the cap at x = -7.02.

mount_top.note: Top of the tall part of the motor mount (motor side) above the bottom face of the chassis plate, corners with the radius mount_corner_r (manual step 10).

mount_corner_r.note: Radius of the top corners of the tall part of the motor mount.

mount_step_x.note: Step between the low part of the motor mount (bulkhead side, with the bearing) and the tall part (motor side): beside the end of the top brace (x = 17.24, 34.6 above the bottom face of the chassis plate), 0.76 clearance.

mount_low_top.note: Top of the low part of the motor mount above the bottom face of the chassis plate: bottom of the top brace 34.6 minus the height of the cap 10.2 (measured MM3 23.2 gives 25.2, 0.8 higher: open point). Depth of the U notch from this face: 10.5 (measured MM2 10.3); 0.2 above the bearing NBA298.

cap_h.note: Cap of the motor mount (second part of NBA201, manual step 25): height 10.2 (caliper, MM4). It fixes the motor mount to the top brace with the screws M3x18 through the top brace.

cap_w.note: Width of the cap across the car (centred on the pinion axis); its depth is the thickness of the motor mount.

cap_notch_r.note: Semicircular notch along y in the top face of the cap (parts list NBA201), below the hole B09 of the top brace (manual step 25: set screw M3x3 in the cap).

cap_screws.note: Through holes of the cap for the 2 screws M3x18 (manual step 25): holes B10 and B11 of the speedrun top brace above the motor mount (chassis plate coordinates x, y).

cap_hole_d.note: Through holes of the cap for the screws M3x18.

motor_screw_spacing.note: 540 motors: 2 screws M3 on a circle of 25 (12.5 above and below the motor axis). The motor axis lies at the height of the pinion axis (middle long hole of the motor mount, manual step 10).

motor_slot_x.note: Range of the motor axis across the car (long holes): centre distance to the pinion axis for a 72T 48DP spur gear and motor pinions of 30 to 45 teeth: 27.0 to 31.0, plus 2.0 at each end. Inside the motor window (x = 16.59 to 40.06).

motor_screw_slot_w.note: Width of the long holes of the motor screws M3 (above and below the motor axis).

motor_shaft_slot_w.note: Width of the long hole for the motor shaft and the bearing boss of 540 motors, bigger than the long holes of the screws.

mount_bearing.note: Bearing NBA298 5x10x4 of the rear pinion shaft in the motor mount (manual step 5), centred in the motor mount.

shaft_d.note: Diameter of the rod of the centre driveshaft (owner).

pin_d.note: Diameter of the metal pins of the driveshaft (approx. as NBA255 2.0x7.6), fixed on the shaft at the centres of the ball ends, part of the model of the shaft. 0.1 smaller than the slots.

pin_length.note: Length of the metal pins, 1.05 inside the outer diameter of the cup joints.

axial_play.note: Total axial play of the shaft: follows from the measured length of the shaft (173.0, ruler; pins 167.9 apart) and the positions of the cup joints; in the centred position each pin has half of it to the closed end of its slot.

outdrive_gap.note: Diff outdrives: gap between the side face of the bulkhead (lip opening of the diff bearing) and the back face of the outdrive.

outdrive_od.note: Diff outdrives: outer diameter (lip opening of the bulkhead 12.28).

outdrive_length.note: Diff outdrives: length beyond the side face of the bulkhead.

outdrive_bore_d.note: Diff outdrives: bore for the end of the dogbone (CVD drive shaft), wall 1.2 (owner: thinner walls).

outdrive_bore_depth.note: Diff outdrives: depth of the bore.

outdrive_slot_w.note: Diff outdrives: width of the two slots for the holding pin of the dogbone (pin 2.0).

outdrive_slot_len.note: Diff outdrives: length of the two slots from the open end.

ball_d.note: Diameter of the ball ends of the centre driveshaft (ruler photo: pin centre 2.5 to 2.6 from the tip). Clearance in the bore of the cup joints: 0.665 on the radius. Neck of the ball diameter up to 4.0 from the centre of the ball, then the rod.

mount_notch_d.note: Width of the U-shaped notch of the bearing seat (MM1), centred on the pinion axis.

mount_lip.note: Lip of the bearing seat on the side toward End A (front, cup joint side): width 1.0 (caliper, MM7) and width of the U-shaped opening of the lip 8.0 (assumption: holds the outer ring of the bearing). The bearing NBA298 lies against the lip.

flange_gap.note: Gap between the end face of the pinion housing and the flange of the rear pinion shaft (the flange lies against the inner ring of the outer bearing).

press_fit_flats.note: Press fit shape of the rear pinion shaft for the pinion and the cup joint (owner): diameter 5.0 with two flats, width across the flats 4.2 (not measured). The bores of the pinion and of the cup joint have the same shape.

pinion.note: Pinion NBA207 (simplified straight bevel gear): teeth 17 (owner; gear ratio of the manual 2.47 = 42/17), outer diameter 14.1 (bulkhead measurement no. 29), root diameter 10.8, length 4.1 (side photo of the front pinion shaft, scaled with the bearing 4.0; large end at the bearing), pitch cone angle 22 degrees (atan 17/42): the teeth converge to the apex of the pitch cone (15.6 in front of the back face); front end 0.71 of the back end.

pinion_countersink.note: Countersink of the pinion for the countersunk screw M3x6 NBA279 (manual step 5): diameter at the front face and depth; the screw goes into the axial thread of the shaft.

pinion_thread_depth.note: Axial thread M3 in the pinion end of the rear pinion shaft (tap drill 2.5): drill depth; the screw M3x6 engages approx. 4.3.

spur_holes.note: Lightening holes of the spur gear: radius, diameter, number, angle of the first hole (photos of the owner): 4 holes between the screws and 8 holes outside the flange.

spur_spigot.note: Spigot of the rear pinion shaft from the flange through the spur gear (centring of the spur gear): diameter and length beyond the spur gear on the cup joint side (photo of the owner, scaled with the bearing 10.0).

bearing_shoulder_d.note: Thinner shoulder of the rear pinion shaft between the spigot and the bearing NBA298 in the motor mount: its face lies against the inner ring of the bearing and holds the bearing in place (owner).

diff_ring_teeth.note: Ring gear of the differential: 42 teeth (owner), meshes with the pinion 17T (gear ratio 2.47, manual).

diff_ring_od.note: Outer diameter of the ring gear (owner; bulkhead measurement no. 27: 31.93). Ring gear recess of the bulkhead: radius 16.4.

diff_ring_back_x.note: Back face of the ring gear from the plane of the pinion axis (photo with the diff installed, bulkhead parameter ring_recess_x_outer).

diff_ring_tip_x.note: Tips of the ring gear teeth from the plane of the pinion axis (face toward the case and the pinion): inner end of the ring gear recess of the bulkhead 4.5 plus 0.4 (photo with the diff installed: approx. 5.0); clearance to the roots of the pinion.

diff_ring_root.note: Root cone of the ring gear teeth: x of the root at the outer diameter and slope dx/dr (root cone approx. 66.7 degrees); the roots lie behind the tips of the pinion, which is fixed by the pinion seat of the bulkhead. Mesh with the pinion: no overlap, smallest clearance 0.02.

diff_ring_teeth_r_in.note: Inner radius of the toothed band of the ring gear: 0.2 above the diff case (26.0); the pinion meshes with the band from radius 14.05 to 15.9.

diff_ring_tooth_half.note: Half widths of the ring gear teeth at the tip and at the root, as fractions of the pitch at the radius (straight flanks, simplified, as the pinion).

diff_ring_phase.note: Turn of the ring gear teeth about the diff axis (degrees): a tooth gap of the ring gear faces the pinion, a tooth of the pinion lies in it.

diff_case_d.note: Outer diameter of the black diff case (owner). Case cavity of the bulkhead: radius 13.5.

diff_case_len.note: Length of the case with the diameter 26.0, measured from the teeth of the ring gear (owner); then the case gets gradually thinner up to the bearing.

diff_case_taper_end.note: End of the taper of the diff case on the side opposite the ring gear: x and radius (photos of the owner), then the hub to the bearing.

diff_hub_d.note: Hubs of the diff on both sides between the case or the ring gear and the bearings (shoulder for the inner ring of the bearings NBA299).

diff_bearing.note: Bearings NBA299 10x15x4 of the differential (manual, bulkhead parameter diff_bearing).

diff_bearing_x.note: Inner and outer face of the diff bearings from the plane of the pinion axis: the diff with both bearings measures 30.0 (bulkhead measurement no. 28), centred between the lips of the bulkhead (inner faces 15.35, 0.35 play on each side).

outdrive_shank.note: Diff outdrives: hexagon shaft (press fit, 5.6 across the flats, owner) from the front face of the side gear (x = 2.9 from the centre) through the shims, the hexagon bore of the ring gear or of the case hub and the lip opening of the bulkhead to the cup (x = 17.54). The side gear sits on it inside, the cup of the outdrive outside.

diff_center_x.note: Centre of the inner gears of the differential (axis of the cross pin) from the plane of the pinion axis: in the middle between the outdrive cups, so both outdrives are the same part.

diff_side_gear.note: Side gears of the differential (2 pieces): 14 teeth (owner), module 1.0 (outer diameter approx. 14.9 from the photo of the owner; with the spider gears 9T: pitch cone angle 57.3 degrees, outer diameter 15.1), front face and back face from the centre (derived). They sit on the hexagon press fits of the outdrives.

diff_spider.note: Spider gears of the differential (2 pieces, owner): 9 teeth, module 1.0 (pitch cone angle 32.7 degrees, outer diameter approx. 10.7), front face and back face from the centre along the cross pin (derived).

diff_pin.note: Cross pin of the spider gears: diameter and length (photo of the owner, scaled with the spider gear 10.7). Its ends sit in bores of the case wall, with slots toward the ring gear for the mounting.

diff_press_fit_hex.note: Press fit of the side gears on the outdrives (owner): hexagon, 5.6 across the flats (photo of the owner, scaled with the ring gear 31.8).

diff_side_shims.note: Shims behind each side gear (owner: 3 thin shims): number, thickness, inner and outer diameter (thickness and diameters assumed).

diff_spider_shim.note: Shim behind each spider gear (owner: 1 shim): thickness (assumed), inner and outer diameter (photo of the owner).

diff_case_cavity.note: Inner space of the diff case: radius, flat walls at the shims of the spider gears (distance from the axis) and inner wall behind the shims of the side gear on the case side (x).

diff_ring_opening.note: Central opening of the ring gear, in which the side gear sits (diameter, photo of the owner), and shoulder for the shims of the side gear (x from the centre, derived).

diff_screws.note: 4 screws of the ring gear into the case (owner; photos: holes approx. 2 on a radius of 10.7, at 45 degrees to the cross pin): number, radius, clearance holes through the ring gear (M2, 2.2), tap drill M2 in the case (1.6) and its depth from the face of the case. The screw heads sit on the back face of the ring gear.

diff_journal_d.note: Journals of the hubs of the ring gear and of the case for the bearings NBA299 (inner diameter 10.0), from x = +-11.0 to +-15.0; hexagon bore for the shaft of the outdrive through the hubs.
